gui.thecatalog.desc.no_recipes: No recipe makes it, so it has to be found or gathered.
gui.thecatalog.desc.no_uses: It isn't used in any recipe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone: The most common block underground. Mining it without Silk Touch gives cobblestone, which you can smelt back into stone. Smelt stone again for smooth stone, or cut it into bricks, stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.granite: A speckled pink stone found in large patches underground. It can also be crafted from diorite and nether quartz. Polish it for a smoother building block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_grani: Granite smoothed into a clean, warm-pink building block. Craft four granite in a square, or use a stonecutter. It also comes as stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diorite: A pale, speckled stone found in patches underground. It can be crafted from cobblestone and nether quartz. Diorite is itself an ingredient for granite and andesite.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_diori: Diorite polished into a bright, even white block. Craft four diorite in a square, or use a stonecutter. Stairs and slabs are available too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.andesite: A grey, grainy stone found in patches underground. It can be crafted from diorite and cobblestone. Builders like it as a softer alternative to plain stone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_andes: Andesite polished into a smooth grey block. Craft four andesite in a square, or use a stonecutter. It also comes as stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate: The dark stone that replaces regular stone below height 0. It is slower to mine than stone. Without Silk Touch it drops cobbled deepslate.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobbled_deepsl: What deepslate drops when mined normally. It works like cobblestone in most recipes, including furnaces and stone tools. Polish it, or cut it into bricks and tiles.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_deeps: Cobbled deepslate polished into a dark, clean building block. Craft it from four cobbled deepslate or use a stonecutter. It also comes as stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.calcite: A soft white stone that forms the middle layer of amethyst geodes. It also appears near some mountain peaks. It is purely decorative and cannot be crafted.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff: A grey volcanic stone found deep underground, often around ore veins. Trial chambers are built largely from tuff and its variants. Stonecut it into bricks, polished blocks and more.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_slab: Half a block of tuff. It is handy for floors, steps and shelves. Craft three tuff in a row for six slabs, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_stairs: Tuff shaped into stairs. They let you and mobs walk up a block without jumping. Craft six tuff in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_wall: A wall made of tuff that connects to its neighbours. Mobs cannot jump over walls. Craft six tuff in two rows, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_tuff: Tuff carved with a decorative pattern. It is a common accent inside trial chambers. Craft two tuff slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_tuff: Tuff polished into a smooth, even block. It is used to make tuff bricks. Craft four tuff in a square, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_tuff_: Half a block of polished tuff. Use it for neat floors and ledges. Craft three in a row, or cut it with a stonecutter.
Stairs made of polished tuff. They give a clean, smooth step. Craft six in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter.
A connecting wall of polished tuff. Mobs cannot jump over it. Craft six in two rows, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_bricks: Neat bricks of tuff, common in trial chambers. They make sturdy-looking walls and floors. Craft four polished tuff in a square, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_brick_sla: Half a block of tuff bricks. It is useful for trims, floors and roofs. Craft three in a row, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_brick_sta: Stairs made of tuff bricks. They match the bricks for seamless builds. Craft six in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tuff_brick_wal: A connecting wall of tuff bricks. Mobs cannot jump over it. Craft six in two rows, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_tuff_: Tuff bricks carved with a frame. They are a common accent in trial chambers. Craft two tuff brick slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dripstone_bloc: A brown stone block from dripstone caves. Pointed dripstone grows on it when water drips from above. Craft four pointed dripstone into one block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.grass_block: Dirt with a living layer of grass on top. You need Silk Touch to collect it; otherwise it drops dirt. Grass spreads to nearby dirt in light, and bone meal grows plants on it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dirt: The most basic ground block. Plant saplings in it, or till it into farmland with a hoe. Mix it with gravel for coarse dirt, or wet it with a water bottle to make mud.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.coarse_dirt: Dirt that grass cannot spread onto, good for paths that stay bare. Craft two dirt and two gravel to make four. A hoe turns it into regular dirt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.podzol: A brown, leaf-covered soil from old-growth taiga and jungles. Mushrooms grow on it at any light level. Collect it with Silk Touch; otherwise it drops dirt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rooted_dirt: Dirt laced with roots, found beneath azalea trees above lush caves. Hanging roots grow from its underside. A hoe turns it into dirt and gives hanging roots.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mud: Wet, squishy ground found in mangrove swamps. Pour a water bottle on dirt to make your own. Combine it with wheat for packed mud, the base of mud bricks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_nylium: A red, fungus-covered netherrack from crimson forests. Bone meal grows crimson fungi and roots on it. Without Silk Touch it drops netherrack.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_nylium: A teal, fungus-covered netherrack from warped forests. Bone meal grows warped fungi and roots on it. Without Silk Touch it drops netherrack.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobblestone: The rubble left when you mine stone. It is one of the first materials you gather, used for stone tools, furnaces and many building blocks. Smelt it to get stone back.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_planks: Basic wooden boards made from oak logs; one log gives four planks. Planks go into crafting tables, sticks, chests, doors, boats and much more. They also burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_planks: Dark wooden boards made from spruce logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. Use them for spruce-coloured stairs, doors and boats.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_planks: Pale wooden boards made from birch logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. Use them for light birch furniture and building pieces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_planks: Warm, reddish boards made from jungle logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. Use them for jungle-coloured doors, stairs and boats.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_planks: Bright orange boards made from acacia logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. They make striking orange building pieces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_planks: Soft pink boards made from cherry logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. Use them for pink doors, signs and boats.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_plank: Deep brown boards made from dark oak logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. They give rich, dark furniture and building pieces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_plank: Red-tinted boards made from mangrove logs; one log gives four planks. They work in any recipe that takes planks. Use them for mangrove-coloured building pieces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_planks: Yellow, striped boards made from blocks of bamboo; one block gives two planks. They work in plank recipes. They also craft into bamboo mosaic and bamboo rafts.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_planks: Magenta boards made from crimson stems; one stem gives four planks. Like all Nether wood, they don't burn. That makes them safe near lava, but useless as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_planks: Teal boards made from warped stems; one stem gives four planks. Like all Nether wood, they don't burn. That makes them safe near lava, but useless as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_mosaic: A patterned bamboo block with a woven look. Craft it from two bamboo slabs stacked. It has its own stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_sapling: A young oak tree, dropped by oak leaves. Plant it in dirt or grass and give it light to grow. Bone meal speeds it up, and it sometimes grows into a large branching oak.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_sapling: A young spruce tree, dropped by spruce leaves. Plant one for a normal spruce. Four in a 2x2 square grow a giant spruce.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_sapling: A young birch tree, dropped by birch leaves. Birches grow tall and thin. They need only a 1x1 space with room above.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_sapling: A young jungle tree, dropped by jungle leaves. One sapling grows a small tree. Four in a 2x2 square grow a towering jungle tree.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_sapling: A young acacia tree from savannas. It grows into a tree with a bent trunk and a flat, layered canopy. Bone meal speeds up its growth.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_sapling: A young cherry tree from cherry groves. It grows into a wide tree with pink blossoms. The blossoms scatter falling petals around it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_sapli: A young dark oak tree. It only grows when four are planted in a 2x2 square. The result is a thick, wide tree with lots of wood.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_propa: The seed of a mangrove tree, hanging from mangrove leaves. Plant it on mud, dirt or clay, even under water. Bone meal on a hanging propagule makes it grow.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bedrock: The unbreakable floor of the Overworld and the floor and roof of the Nether. It cannot be mined in Survival mode. Nothing can dig past it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sand: A loose block found on beaches and in deserts. It falls when nothing is under it. Smelt it into glass, or craft four into sandstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.suspicious_san: Sand that hides a buried item, found in desert pyramids, desert wells and warm ocean ruins. Brush it carefully to uncover loot such as pottery sherds. Breaking it destroys the item.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.suspicious_gra: Gravel that hides a buried item, found in trail ruins and cold ocean ruins. Brush it carefully to reveal the loot. Mining it ruins the find.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_sand: The orange sand of badlands. It falls like regular sand and smelts into ordinary glass. Craft four into red sandstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gravel: A loose stone block that falls when unsupported. Mining it sometimes drops flint instead. Flint is needed for arrows and flint and steel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.coal_ore: The most common ore, found in exposed stone at almost any height. It drops coal, the classic fuel. Coal is also the key to torches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_coal: Coal ore set in deepslate. It is rare, since coal mostly forms above the deepslate layer. It drops coal like its stone version.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_ore: A common ore with orange-brown specks. It drops raw iron, which you smelt into iron ingots. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_iron: Iron ore set in deepslate, found deep underground. It drops raw iron for smelting. It takes a little longer to mine than the stone version.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_ore: An ore with green and orange specks, common around the middle of the world. It drops several raw copper at once. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_copp: Copper ore set in deepslate. It drops several raw copper like its stone version. It is slower to mine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gold_ore: An ore with bright yellow specks, found deep underground and plentiful in badlands. It drops raw gold. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_gold: Gold ore set in deepslate, where most gold is found. It drops raw gold for smelting. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.redstone_ore: An ore with red specks found deep underground. It glows when touched and drops several redstone dust. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_reds: Redstone ore set in deepslate, where it is most common. It glows when touched. It drops several redstone dust.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.emerald_ore: A rare ore found only in mountain biomes. It drops an emerald, the currency villagers trade in. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_emer: Emerald ore set in deepslate, very rare and only in mountains. It drops an emerald. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lapis_ore: An ore with blue specks found underground. It drops a handful of lapis lazuli, used for enchanting and blue dye. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_lapi: Lapis lazuli ore set in deepslate. It drops a handful of lapis lazuli. That lapis powers your enchanting table.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_ore: A rare ore with pale blue gems, found deep underground. It drops a diamond, needed for the best tools before netherite. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_diam: Diamond ore set in deepslate, where nearly all diamonds are found. It drops a diamond. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_gold_or: Netherrack streaked with gold, common across the Nether. It drops a handful of gold nuggets. Any pickaxe can mine it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_quartz_: Netherrack with white quartz crystals, common in the Nether. It drops nether quartz, used for redstone parts and quartz blocks. Mining it gives plenty of experience.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ancient_debris: A very rare, blast-resistant block hidden low in the Nether. Smelt it into netherite scrap, the start of netherite gear. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe; the item survives lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.coal_block: Nine pieces of coal packed together. It stores coal compactly. As fuel it burns ten times longer than a single coal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_iron_block: Nine raw iron packed into one block. It stores ore compactly. Craft it back into nine raw iron when you are ready to smelt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_copper_blo: Nine raw copper packed into one block. It stores ore compactly. Craft it back into nine raw copper when you are ready to smelt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_gold_block: Nine raw gold packed into one block. It stores ore compactly. Craft it back into nine raw gold when you are ready to smelt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.heavy_core: A dense, heavy block found in ominous vaults of trial chambers. Combine it with a breeze rod to craft the mace. It can be placed, but does little on its own.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.amethyst_block: A purple crystal block found in amethyst geodes. It chimes softly when walked on. Craft it from four amethyst shards.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.budding_amethy: The source of amethyst in geodes; buds and clusters slowly grow on its sides. It cannot be collected, even with Silk Touch. Pistons can't move it either, so farm geodes where they stand.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_block: Nine iron ingots packed into a block. It forms the body of an iron golem and the base of a beacon. It is also part of the anvil recipe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_block: Nine copper ingots packed into a block. Over time it oxidizes from orange to green. Wax it with honeycomb to freeze its look, or scrape it with an axe to undo oxidation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gold_block: Nine gold ingots packed into a block. It works as a beacon base. Piglins get angry if they see you break one.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_block: Nine diamonds packed into a block. It is a compact store of diamonds. It also works as a valuable beacon base.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_bloc: Nine netherite ingots packed into a block, the most valuable storage block. It resists explosions and works as a beacon base. As an item, it survives lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_copper: Copper in its first stage of oxidation, with brown patches. It keeps aging unless waxed with honeycomb. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_copp: Copper in its third stage of oxidation, mostly green. Wax it with honeycomb to keep the look. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_coppe: Copper fully oxidized to teal green. It no longer changes on its own. An axe or a lightning strike can scrape off the patina.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_coppe: A decorative copper block with a carved pattern. It oxidizes over time like other copper. Craft it from two cut copper slabs, or use a stonecutter.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_chisel: Chiseled copper starting to oxidize. It keeps aging unless waxed with honeycomb. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_chis: Chiseled copper that is mostly oxidized. Wax it with honeycomb to keep this look. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_chise: Chiseled copper fully oxidized to teal. It no longer changes on its own. An axe scrapes it back toward fresh copper.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_copper: Copper cut into a tiled pattern. Craft four copper blocks for four cut copper, or use a stonecutter. It oxidizes over time like all copper.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_cut_co: Cut copper with its first patches of oxidation. It keeps aging unless waxed with honeycomb. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_cut_: Cut copper that is mostly green with oxidation. Wax it with honeycomb to keep it this way. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_cut_c: Cut copper fully oxidized to teal. It no longer changes on its own. An axe or lightning can restore its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_copper_sta: Stairs made of cut copper. They oxidize over time like all copper. Wax them with honeycomb to keep their shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_cut_co: Cut copper stairs beginning to oxidize. They keep aging unless waxed. An axe scrapes them back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_cut_: Cut copper stairs that are mostly oxidized. Wax them to keep this look. An axe scrapes them back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_cut_c: Cut copper stairs fully oxidized to teal. They no longer change on their own. An axe can restore their shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_copper_sla: Half a block of cut copper. It oxidizes over time like all copper. Wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_cut_co: A cut copper slab beginning to oxidize. It keeps aging unless waxed. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_cut_: A cut copper slab that is mostly oxidized. Wax it with honeycomb to keep this look. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_cut_c: A cut copper slab fully oxidized to teal. It no longer changes on its own. An axe or lightning can restore its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_copper_b: A copper block sealed with honeycomb. Wax stops it from oxidizing, so it stays bright orange forever. Scrape the wax off with an axe if you want it to age again.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: Exposed copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax locks in its first patches of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: Weathered copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax keeps its mostly green look from changing. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: Fully oxidized copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax keeps its teal patina exactly as it is. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_chiseled: Chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. It keeps its fresh orange shine. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: Exposed chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its look is frozen at the first stage of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: Weathered chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look won't change. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: Oxidized chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_cut_copp: Cut copper sealed with honeycomb. It stays bright and never oxidizes. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: Exposed cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its look is frozen at the first stage of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: Weathered cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look won't change. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: Oxidized cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_cut_copp: Cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. They keep their fresh shine. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: Exposed cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their look won't change further. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: Weathered cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their mostly green look is locked in. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: Oxidized cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_cut_copp: A cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. It keeps its fresh shine. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: An exposed cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its look won't change further. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: A weathered cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look is locked in. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: An oxidized cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_log: The trunk of an oak tree and the first thing most players collect. Each log crafts into four oak planks. Smelt it for charcoal, or strip it with an axe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_log: The dark trunk of a spruce tree from taigas and snowy forests. Each log crafts into four spruce planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_log: The white, spotted trunk of a birch tree. Each log crafts into four birch planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_log: The trunk of a jungle tree, often covered in vines. Cocoa beans grow only on jungle logs. Each log crafts into four jungle planks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_log: The grey trunk of an acacia tree from savannas. Each log crafts into four orange acacia planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_log: The dark, pink-hearted trunk of a cherry tree. Each log crafts into four cherry planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_log: The thick trunk of a dark oak from dark forests. Each log crafts into four dark oak planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_log: The trunk of a mangrove tree from mangrove swamps. Each log crafts into four mangrove planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_roots: The tangled roots at the base of mangrove trees. You can see through them, and they can hold water. Combine them with mud for muddy mangrove roots.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.muddy_mangrove: Mangrove roots packed with mud, found under mangrove trees. Craft them from mangrove roots and mud. They are a natural-looking decorative block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_stem: The stem of a huge crimson fungus from the Nether. It works like a log and crafts into four crimson planks. Nether wood never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_stem: The stem of a huge warped fungus from the Nether. It works like a log and crafts into four warped planks. Nether wood never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_block: Nine bamboo stalks bundled into a block. It crafts into two bamboo planks. Strip it with an axe for a smoother look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_oak_l: An oak log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Builders use it for clean, light beams.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_spruc: A spruce log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Its warm brown grain suits cabins and beams.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_birch: A birch log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It gives a pale, smooth beam.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_jungl: A jungle log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It makes a warm, reddish beam.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_acaci: An acacia log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Its bright orange surface stands out in builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_cherr: A cherry log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It reveals a soft pink grain.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_dark_: A dark oak log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It makes a deep brown beam.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_mangr: A mangrove log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It reveals a rich red grain.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_crims: A crimson stem with its outer layer removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_warpe: A warped stem with its outer layer removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_oak_w: Oak wood with the bark stripped off on every side. Strip oak wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a smooth, all-sided building block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_spruc: Spruce wood stripped on every side. Strip spruce wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It shows the same grain on all faces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_birch: Birch wood stripped on every side. Strip birch wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a pale, uniform building block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_jungl: Jungle wood stripped on every side. Strip jungle wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a warm, uniform building block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_acaci: Acacia wood stripped on every side. Strip acacia wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is bright orange on every face.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_cherr: Cherry wood stripped on every side. Strip cherry wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is pink on every face.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_dark_: Dark oak wood stripped on every side. Strip dark oak wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is deep brown on every face.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_mangr: Mangrove wood stripped on every side. Strip mangrove wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is red on every face.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_crims: Crimson hyphae stripped on every side. Strip hyphae with an axe, or craft four stripped stems into three. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_warpe: Warped hyphae stripped on every side. Strip hyphae with an axe, or craft four stripped stems into three. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stripped_bambo: A block of bamboo with its outer layer stripped by an axe. It crafts into two bamboo planks. It has a smoother, paler look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_wood: Oak bark on all six sides, with no ring pattern on the ends. Craft four oak logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_wood: Spruce bark on all six sides. Craft four spruce logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_wood: White birch bark on all six sides. Craft four birch logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_wood: Jungle bark on all six sides. Craft four jungle logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_wood: Grey acacia bark on all six sides. Craft four acacia logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_wood: Dark cherry bark on all six sides. Craft four cherry logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_wood: Dark oak bark on all six sides. Craft four dark oak logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_wood: Mangrove bark on all six sides. Craft four mangrove logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_hyphae: Crimson stem texture on all six sides. Craft four crimson stems into three. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_hyphae: Warped stem texture on all six sides. Craft four warped stems into three. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_leaves: The leaves of an oak tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings, sticks and sometimes apples. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_leaves: The needles of a spruce tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_leaves: The light leaves of a birch tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_leaves: The dense leaves of a jungle tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_leaves: The leaves of an acacia tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_leaves: The pink blossoms of a cherry tree, which drift petals as they fall. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_leave: The leaves of a dark oak tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings, sticks and sometimes apples. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_leave: The leaves of a mangrove tree, where propagules hang. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping sticks. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.azalea_leaves: The leaves of an azalea tree, found above lush caves. They drop azalea bushes and sticks as they decay. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flowering_azal: Azalea leaves dotted with pink flowers. They drop flowering azalea bushes and sticks as they decay. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sponge: A dry sponge that soaks up water around it when placed. It then turns into a wet sponge. Sponges come from ocean monuments and elder guardians.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wet_sponge: A sponge full of water. Dry it in a furnace to use it again, or place it in the Nether to dry it instantly. While wet, it drips water from its underside.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glass: A clear block made by smelting sand. It breaks without Silk Touch, so handle it carefully. Craft it into panes, bottles or stained glass.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tinted_glass: Dark glass that blocks light but lets you see through. Craft it from glass and amethyst shards. Unlike glass, it drops itself when broken.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lapis_block: Nine lapis lazuli packed into a block. It stores lapis compactly. It is purely decorative beyond that.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sandstone: A soft stone made from four sand, also found under deserts and beaches. It can be cut, chiseled or smoothed. Desert villages and temples are built from it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_sands: Sandstone carved with a creeper-like pattern, seen in desert pyramids. Craft it from two sandstone slabs stacked. A stonecutter works too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_sandstone: Sandstone cut into a clean, banded block. Craft four sandstone into four cut sandstone, or use a stonecutter. It has its own slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobweb: A sticky web found in mineshafts, strongholds and trial chambers. Anything caught in it moves very slowly. A sword breaks it quickly and drops string; shears collect the web itself.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.short_grass: Short tufts of grass covering most grassland. Breaking it sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears, or use bone meal to grow tall grass.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fern: A small fern common in taigas and jungles. It sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears, or use bone meal to grow a large fern.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.azalea: A small round shrub found above lush caves. Bone meal grows it into an azalea tree with rooted dirt below. It can also go in a flower pot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flowering_azal: An azalea shrub covered in pink flowers. Bone meal grows it into a flowering azalea tree. It looks lovely in a flower pot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dead_bush: A dry shrub found in deserts and badlands. Breaking it drops sticks. Collect it with shears to plant elsewhere.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.seagrass: Grass that grows on the ocean floor. Collect it with shears. Bone meal underwater spreads it and grows tall seagrass.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sea_pickle: A small glowing creature found in warm ocean reefs. Up to four fit in one block, glowing brighter the more there are, but only under water. Smelt it into lime dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_wool: Soft wool sheared from white sheep or crafted from four string. It can be dyed any color. Wool makes beds, carpets and banners, and it muffles vibrations for sculk sensors.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_wool: Wool dyed orange, from orange sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes orange beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_wool: Wool dyed magenta, from magenta sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes magenta beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_woo: Wool dyed light blue, from light blue sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes light blue beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_wool: Wool dyed yellow, from yellow sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes yellow beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_wool: Wool dyed lime, from lime sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes lime beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_wool: Wool dyed pink, from pink sheep or by dyeing wool. Pink sheep are rare in the wild. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_wool: Wool dyed gray, often sheared from naturally gray sheep. It makes gray beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_woo: Wool dyed light gray, often sheared from naturally light gray sheep. It makes light gray beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cyan_wool: Wool dyed cyan, from cyan sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes cyan beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purple_wool: Wool dyed purple, from purple sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes purple beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_wool: Wool dyed blue, from blue sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes blue beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_wool: Wool dyed brown, often sheared from naturally brown sheep. It makes brown beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_wool: Wool dyed green, from green sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes green beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_wool: Wool dyed red, from red sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes red beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.black_wool: Wool dyed black, often sheared from naturally black sheep. It makes black beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dandelion: A cheerful yellow flower common in plains. Craft it into yellow dye. Bees love it, and it can be fed to rabbits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.poppy: A bright red flower found almost everywhere grass grows. Craft it into red dye. Iron golems sometimes offer one to villagers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_orchid: A light blue flower that grows only in swamps. Craft it into light blue dye. In a suspicious stew it gives saturation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.allium: A round purple flower found in flower forests. Craft it into magenta dye. In a suspicious stew it grants fire resistance.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.azure_bluet: A tiny white flower found in plains and meadows. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it causes blindness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_tulip: A red tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into red dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_tulip: An orange tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into orange dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_tulip: A white tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_tulip: A pink tulip found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into pink dye. In a suspicious stew it causes weakness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxeye_daisy: A white daisy with a yellow centre, common in plains. Craft it into light gray dye. In a suspicious stew it gives regeneration.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cornflower: A vivid blue flower found in plains and flower forests. Craft it into blue dye. In a suspicious stew it gives jump boost.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lily_of_the_va: A small flower with white bells, found in forests. Craft it into white dye. In a suspicious stew it causes poison.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wither_rose: A dark flower that appears where the Wither kills a mob. Touching it inflicts the wither effect on most creatures. Craft it into black dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.torchflower: An ancient flower grown from seeds that sniffers dig up. Its glowing petals don't actually give off light. Craft it into orange dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pitcher_plant: A tall ancient plant grown from a pitcher pod, which sniffers dig up. It takes two blocks of space. Craft it into two cyan dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spore_blossom: A pink flower that hangs from the ceilings of lush caves. It releases drifting green spores into the air around it. It must be placed on the underside of a block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_mushroom: A small mushroom that grows in dim light and spreads on its own. It goes into mushroom stew, rabbit stew and fermented spider eyes. Bone meal can grow it into a huge mushroom.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_mushroom: A red-capped mushroom that grows in dim light and spreads on its own. It is used for mushroom stew and suspicious stew. Bone meal can grow it into a huge mushroom.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_fungus: A red fungus from crimson forests. Plant it on crimson nylium and use bone meal to grow a huge crimson fungus. Hoglins can be bred with it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_fungus: A teal fungus from warped forests. Plant it on warped nylium and use bone meal to grow a huge warped fungus. Striders love it, and hoglins avoid it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_roots: Red roots that grow on the floor of crimson forests. They are purely decorative. You can plant them in a flower pot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_roots: Teal roots that grow on the floor of warped forests. They are purely decorative. You can plant them in a flower pot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_sprouts: Tiny teal sprouts found in warped forests. Collect them with shears. They are purely decorative.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weeping_vines: Red vines that hang down from crimson forest ceilings. You can climb them. Bone meal makes them grow longer.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.twisting_vines: Teal vines that grow upward in warped forests. You can climb them. Bone meal makes them grow taller.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sugar_cane: A tall green reed that grows next to water on sand, dirt or grass. Craft it into sugar or paper. It grows up to three blocks tall.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.kelp: A tall seaweed growing in most oceans. Smelt it into dried kelp, a quick snack. Dried kelp blocks make good fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.moss_carpet: A thin layer of moss that sits on top of blocks. Craft two moss blocks into three carpets. It gives floors a soft, overgrown look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_petals: Fallen cherry blossom petals that carpet cherry groves. Up to four fit in one block. Craft them into pink dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.moss_block: A soft green block from lush caves. Bone meal spreads moss and plants around it. Combine it with cobblestone or stone bricks for mossy variants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hanging_roots: Thin roots that dangle beneath rooted dirt. They are purely decorative. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.big_dripleaf: A large leaf found in lush caves that you can stand on. It tilts and drops you if you stay too long. Bone meal makes it grow taller.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.small_dripleaf: A small two-block-tall dripleaf found in lush caves. Plant it on clay or moss. Bone meal grows it into a big dripleaf.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo: A fast-growing plant from jungles and bamboo forests. Pandas eat it, and it crafts into sticks, scaffolding and blocks of bamboo. It also burns as a quick fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_slab: Half a block of oak planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_slab: Half a block of spruce planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_slab: Half a block of birch planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_slab: Half a block of jungle planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_slab: Half a block of acacia planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_slab: Half a block of cherry planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_slab: Half a block of dark oak planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_slab: Half a block of mangrove planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Place two in one space to make a full block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_slab: Half a block of bamboo planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Two stacked slabs craft into bamboo mosaic.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_mosaic_: Half a block of bamboo mosaic. Craft three mosaic blocks in a row for six slabs. It keeps the woven pattern.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_slab: Half a block of crimson planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_slab: Half a block of warped planks. Craft three planks in a row for six slabs. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_slab: Half a block of stone. Craft three stone in a row for six slabs, or use a stonecutter. It is part of the grindstone recipe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_stone_s: Half a block of smooth stone with a clean border. Craft three smooth stone in a row, or use a stonecutter. Village houses often use it for floors.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sandstone_slab: Half a block of sandstone. Craft three sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. Two stacked slabs craft into chiseled sandstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_sandstone_: Half a block of cut sandstone. Craft three cut sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits desert builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.petrified_oak_: A strange slab that looks like oak but behaves like stone. It is a leftover from old versions and can't be obtained in Survival. It doesn't burn and needs a pickaxe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobblestone_sl: Half a block of cobblestone. Craft three cobblestone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It makes cheap paths and roofs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brick_slab: Half a block of bricks. Craft three brick blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It makes cosy roofs and trims.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_brick_sl: Half a block of stone bricks. Craft three stone bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It is common in strongholds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mud_brick_slab: Half a block of mud bricks. Craft three mud bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits earthy, desert-style builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_brick_s: Half a block of nether bricks. Craft three nether bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It is resistant to fire, like the bricks themselves.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz_slab: Half a block of quartz. Craft three quartz blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It gives a clean white finish.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_sandstone_: Half a block of red sandstone. Craft three red sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cut_red_sandst: Half a block of cut red sandstone. Craft three cut red sandstone in a row, or use a stonecutter. It keeps the banded look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purpur_slab: Half a block of purpur. Craft three purpur blocks in a row, or use a stonecutter. Two stacked slabs craft into a purpur pillar.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_sla: Half a block of prismarine. Craft three prismarine in a row, or use a stonecutter. Its color slowly shifts like the original block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_bri: Half a block of prismarine bricks. Craft three prismarine bricks in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits ocean-themed builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_prismarin: Half a block of dark prismarine. Craft three dark prismarine in a row, or use a stonecutter. It suits deep ocean builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_quartz: A quartz block smelted until perfectly smooth. Smelt a block of quartz to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_red_san: Red sandstone smelted smooth. Smelt red sandstone to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_sandsto: Sandstone smelted smooth, found in desert temples and villages. Smelt sandstone to make it. It has its own stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_stone: Stone smelted a second time into a clean, bordered block. It is needed for the blast furnace. Cut it into smooth stone slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bricks: A classic red brick block. Smelt clay balls into bricks, then craft four into a block. It resists fire and has stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bookshelf: A shelf full of books made from planks and three books. Placed near an enchanting table, it unlocks stronger enchantments; fifteen give the maximum. Without Silk Touch it drops three books.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_books: An empty shelf that holds up to six books of any kind. Place and take books one at a time. A comparator reads which slot was used last.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.decorated_pot: A clay pot made from four bricks or pottery sherds, with each sherd showing a picture. It can hold a stack of one kind of item. Breaking it with a tool shatters it back into its pieces.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mossy_cobblest: Cobblestone overgrown with moss, found in dungeons and jungle temples. Craft it from cobblestone with moss or vines. It has stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.obsidian: A very hard, blast-proof block formed when water meets a lava source. It needs a diamond pickaxe to mine. It frames Nether portals and goes into enchanting tables, ender chests and beacons.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.torch: The simplest light source, made from coal or charcoal and a stick. It lights a wide area and keeps most mobs from spawning nearby. It also melts nearby snow and ice.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_rod: A glowing white rod found on End cities. Craft it from a blaze rod and popped chorus fruit. It gives off as much light as a torch and drifts sparkling particles.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chorus_plant: A strange branching plant that grows on End islands. Breaking it drops chorus fruit. If its base is broken, the whole plant falls apart.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chorus_flower: The growing tip of a chorus plant. Plant it on end stone to grow a new chorus plant. Shoot it with a projectile or break it to collect it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purpur_block: A purple block that makes up End cities. Craft four popped chorus fruit into four blocks. It has stairs, slabs and pillars.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purpur_pillar: A decorative purpur column with a ribbed side. Craft it from two purpur slabs stacked. Place it sideways for horizontal beams.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purpur_stairs: Stairs made of purpur. Craft six purpur blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in End cities.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spawner: A cage with a tiny spinning mob inside, found in dungeons, mineshafts and strongholds. It keeps spawning that mob while a player is nearby. It can't be picked up, even with Silk Touch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chest: The basic storage block, crafted from eight planks. It holds 27 stacks; place two side by side for a double chest. A solid block on top stops it from opening.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crafting_table: A table made from four planks that opens the full 3x3 crafting grid. Most tools, blocks and machines need one. It is usually the first thing you craft.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.farmland: Tilled soil made by using a hoe on dirt or grass. Crops grow on it, faster when water is within four blocks. Jumping on it tramples it back into dirt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.furnace: A block made from eight cobblestone that smelts ores and cooks food. Put fuel in the bottom slot and the item on top. Blast furnaces and smokers are faster, more specialised versions.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ladder: A climbable wooden ladder placed against walls. Craft seven sticks into three ladders. It also stops falls if you grab it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobblestone_st: Stairs made of cobblestone. Craft six cobblestone in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are a cheap, sturdy staircase.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.snow: A thin layer of snow that covers cold biomes. Up to eight layers can stack in one block. Dig it with a shovel to collect snowballs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ice: A slippery block found in frozen biomes. It melts into water near bright light and breaks into water unless mined with Silk Touch. Nine ice craft into packed ice.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.snow_block: A full block of snow made from four snowballs. It breaks back into snowballs with a shovel. Stack two with a carved pumpkin to build a snow golem.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cactus: A spiky desert plant that hurts anything touching it. It grows on sand up to three blocks tall. Smelt it into green dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.clay: A grey block found in rivers, swamps and lush caves. It breaks into four clay balls, which smelt into bricks. Craft four balls back into a clay block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jukebox: A music box crafted from eight planks and a diamond. Insert a music disc to play it. Allays dance nearby, and a comparator detects which disc is playing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four oak planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four spruce planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four birch planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four jungle planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four acacia planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four cherry planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four dark oak planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_fence: A wooden fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four mangrove planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_fence: A bamboo fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four bamboo planks and two sticks into three fences. Leads can be tied to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_fence: A crimson fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four crimson planks and two sticks into three fences. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_fence: A warped fence that mobs can't jump over. Craft four warped planks and two sticks into three fences. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pumpkin: A big orange gourd that grows from pumpkin seeds. Use shears on it to carve a face and get seeds. It is used for pumpkin pie and seeds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.carved_pumpkin: A pumpkin with a face cut into it. Wear it to look at endermen safely. Place it on stacked snow or iron blocks to build a golem.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jack_o_lantern: A carved pumpkin with a torch inside. It is one of the brightest light sources. Unlike a torch, it works under water.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherrack: The red rock that makes up most of the Nether. It breaks quickly with any pickaxe. Once lit, it burns forever, and it smelts into nether bricks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.soul_sand: A dark, sandy block from soul sand valleys that slows anything walking on it. Nether wart grows on it, and under water it makes upward bubble columns. It is used to summon the Wither.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.soul_soil: A dark soil from soul sand valleys. Unlike soul sand, it doesn't slow you down. Fire on it burns blue, and it can summon the Wither.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.basalt: A grey volcanic rock common in basalt deltas. It also forms where lava flows over soul soil next to blue ice. Polish it for a smoother look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_basal: Basalt polished into a smooth, ribbed column. Craft four basalt into four, or use a stonecutter. It is found in bastion remnants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smooth_basalt: A smooth dark stone found in the outer layer of amethyst geodes. Smelt basalt to make it. It is purely decorative.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.soul_torch: A torch with a pale blue flame, made with soul sand or soul soil. It is dimmer than a regular torch. Piglins are scared of soul fire.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glowstone: A bright, glowing block hanging from Nether ceilings. It breaks into glowstone dust; four dust craft back into a block. It also charges respawn anchors.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_stone: Stone with a silverfish hiding inside, found in mountains and strongholds. It breaks faster than normal stone, letting the silverfish out. It looks exactly like regular stone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_cobbl: Cobblestone with a silverfish hiding inside. Breaking it releases the silverfish. It looks just like normal cobblestone but breaks faster.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_stone: Stone bricks with a silverfish inside, common in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than real stone bricks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_mossy: Mossy stone bricks hiding a silverfish, found in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_crack: Cracked stone bricks hiding a silverfish, found in strongholds. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_chise: Chiseled stone bricks hiding a silverfish. Breaking them releases the silverfish. They break faster than the real block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.infested_deeps: Deepslate hiding a silverfish, found deep underground. Breaking it releases the silverfish. It breaks faster than real deepslate.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_bricks: Neat stone bricks made from four stone. They are the main block of strongholds. Turn them mossy, crack them in a furnace, or chisel them.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mossy_stone_br: Stone bricks overgrown with moss, found in strongholds and jungle temples. Craft stone bricks with a moss block or vines. They have stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cracked_stone_: Stone bricks with cracks across them. Smelt stone bricks in a furnace to crack them. They give builds a ruined, aged look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_stone: Stone bricks carved with a circular pattern. Craft two stone brick slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. They are common in strongholds and trail ruins.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.packed_mud: Mud firmed up with wheat. Craft one mud and one wheat to make it. Four packed mud craft into mud bricks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mud_bricks: Earthy bricks made from packed mud. Craft four packed mud into four. They have stairs, slabs and walls and suit desert and swamp builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_bric: Dark bricks made from polished deepslate, common in ancient cities. Craft four polished deepslate into four. Smelt them for a cracked version.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cracked_deepsl: Deepslate bricks with cracks across them. Smelt deepslate bricks to make them. They appear in ancient cities.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_tile: Small square tiles of deepslate. Craft four deepslate bricks into four tiles, or use a stonecutter. Smelt them for a cracked version.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cracked_deepsl: Deepslate tiles with cracks across them. Smelt deepslate tiles to make them. They give builds a worn look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_deeps: Deepslate carved with a decorative pattern. Craft two cobbled deepslate slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It appears in ancient cities.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.reinforced_dee: An indestructible block framing the strange portal in ancient cities. It can't be mined in Survival and survives any explosion. It can't be obtained without commands.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_mushroom: The cap of a huge brown mushroom. Breaking it drops a few brown mushrooms. Collect the block itself with Silk Touch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_mushroom_b: The spotted cap of a huge red mushroom. Breaking it drops a few red mushrooms. Collect the block itself with Silk Touch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mushroom_stem: The pale stem of a huge mushroom. It drops nothing unless mined with Silk Touch. It makes a nice off-white building block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_bars: A grid of iron bars that connects to its neighbours. Craft six iron ingots into sixteen. Use them for windows, cells and fences you can see through.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chain: A short iron chain that can hang vertically or lie sideways. Craft it from an iron ingot and two iron nuggets. Hang lanterns and signs from it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glass_pane: A thin sheet of glass that connects to its neighbours. Craft six glass into sixteen panes. It makes slim windows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.melon: A whole melon grown from melon seeds. Breaking it drops several melon slices. Nine slices craft back into a melon.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.vine: Leafy vines that hang from trees in jungles and swamps. You can climb them, and they slowly spread. Collect them with shears.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glow_lichen: A faintly glowing lichen that grows on cave walls. It gives off dim light. Collect it with shears, or spread it with bone meal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brick_stairs: Stairs made of bricks. Craft six brick blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They make cosy, classic roofs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_brick_st: Stairs made of stone bricks. Craft six stone bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in strongholds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mud_brick_stai: Stairs made of mud bricks. Craft six mud bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit earthy builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mycelium: A purple-grey soil found only in mushroom fields. Mushrooms grow on it in any light, and it spreads onto nearby dirt. Without Silk Touch it drops dirt.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lily_pad: A floating leaf found on swamp water. Place it on water to walk across. Boats break lily pads on contact.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_bricks: Dark red bricks that make up nether fortresses. Smelt netherrack into nether brick items, then craft four into a block. They resist fire and ghast fireballs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cracked_nether: Nether bricks with cracks across them. Smelt nether bricks to make them. They appear in bastion remnants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_nethe: Nether bricks carved with a skull-like pattern. Craft two nether brick slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. They appear in bastion remnants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_brick_f: A dark fence of nether bricks, found in nether fortresses. Craft four nether brick blocks and two nether bricks into six. It doesn't connect to wooden fences.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_brick_s: Stairs made of nether bricks, found in nether fortresses. Craft six nether brick blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They don't burn.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk: A dark, pulsing block that spreads across the deep dark. It drops experience when mined; Silk Touch collects it. A hoe mines it fastest.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk_vein: A thin layer of sculk that creeps over surfaces. It drops nothing unless mined with Silk Touch. It spreads when a sculk catalyst blooms nearby.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk_catalyst: A sculk block that blooms when a mob dies nearby, spreading sculk with the dead mob's experience. It drops experience when mined. Silk Touch collects it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk_shrieker: A sculk block that shrieks when a nearby sculk sensor detects a player. Natural shriekers can summon the Warden and give darkness. Placed shriekers just shriek.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.enchanting_tab: A table made from a book, two diamonds and four obsidian. Spend lapis lazuli and experience levels to enchant tools, weapons and armor. Bookshelves around it unlock stronger enchantments.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_portal_fra: The frame of the End portal, found in a stronghold's portal room. Fill all twelve frames with eyes of ender to open the portal. It can't be broken in Survival.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_stone: The pale stone of the End's islands. It resists explosions well. Craft four into end stone bricks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_stone_bric: Bricks made from end stone, found in End cities. Craft four end stone into four. They have stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dragon_egg: A unique egg left on the exit portal after the Ender Dragon is first defeated. It teleports away when hit or clicked. Push it with a piston or let it drop onto a torch to collect it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sandstone_stai: Stairs made of sandstone. Craft six sandstone in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They are common in desert villages.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ender_chest: A chest made from eight obsidian and an eye of ender. Every ender chest opens the same private inventory, wherever you are. Without Silk Touch it drops eight obsidian.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.emerald_block: Nine emeralds packed into a block. It stores emeralds compactly. It also works as a beacon base.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_stairs: Stairs made of oak planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They also burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_stairs: Stairs made of spruce planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit cabins and taiga builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_stairs: Stairs made of birch planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They give a light, clean look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_stairs: Stairs made of jungle planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit warm, reddish builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_stairs: Stairs made of acacia planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They add a bright orange accent.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_stairs: Stairs made of cherry planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit soft pink builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_stair: Stairs made of dark oak planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit rich, dark builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_stair: Stairs made of mangrove planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit red-toned builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_stairs: Stairs made of bamboo planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. They suit bright, tropical builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_mosaic_: Stairs made of bamboo mosaic. Craft six mosaic blocks in a stair shape for four stairs. They keep the woven pattern.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_stairs: Stairs made of crimson planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. Like all Nether wood, they never burn.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_stairs: Stairs made of warped planks. Craft six planks in a stair shape for four stairs. Like all Nether wood, they never burn.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.command_block: A block that runs commands when powered by redstone. It can only be obtained with commands in Creative mode. Map makers use it to build games and contraptions.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beacon: A powerful light crafted from glass, obsidian and a nether star. Placed on a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks, it grants effects such as speed or haste to nearby players. Bigger pyramids unlock more effects and range.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobblestone_wa: A wall of cobblestone that connects to its neighbours. Craft six cobblestone into six walls. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mossy_cobblest: A wall of mossy cobblestone. Craft six mossy cobblestone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brick_wall: A wall of bricks. Craft six brick blocks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_wal: A wall of prismarine. Craft six prismarine into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Its color slowly shifts like the original block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_sandstone_: A wall of red sandstone. Craft six red sandstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mossy_stone_br: A wall of mossy stone bricks. Craft six mossy stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits ruins and overgrown builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.granite_wall: A wall of granite. Craft six granite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_brick_wa: A wall of stone bricks. Craft six stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mud_brick_wall: A wall of mud bricks. Craft six mud bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits earthy builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_brick_w: A wall of nether bricks. Craft six nether brick blocks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It doesn't burn.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.andesite_wall: A wall of andesite. Craft six andesite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_nether_bri: A wall of red nether bricks. Craft six red nether bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It doesn't burn.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sandstone_wall: A wall of sandstone. Craft six sandstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits desert builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_stone_bric: A wall of end stone bricks. Craft six end stone bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It resists explosions well.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diorite_wall: A wall of diorite. Craft six diorite into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blackstone_wal: A wall of blackstone. Craft six blackstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits dark, Nether-style builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: A wall of polished blackstone. Craft six polished blackstone into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
A wall of polished blackstone bricks. Craft six bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It is common in bastion remnants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cobbled_deepsl: A wall of cobbled deepslate. Craft six cobbled deepslate into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_deeps: A wall of polished deepslate. Craft six polished deepslate into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_bric: A wall of deepslate bricks. Craft six deepslate bricks into six walls, or use a stonecutter. It suits ancient city builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.deepslate_tile: A wall of deepslate tiles. Craft six deepslate tiles into six walls, or use a stonecutter. Mobs can't jump over it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.anvil: A heavy block made from three blocks of iron and four iron ingots. Use it to repair, rename and combine enchanted items for experience. It wears out with use and falls like sand.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chipped_anvil: An anvil that has started to wear out. It works like a new anvil. A few more uses or a long fall will damage it further.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.damaged_anvil: An anvil close to breaking. It still works, but its next damage destroys it. Replace it soon.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_quart: A quartz block carved with a pattern. Craft two quartz slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It makes elegant columns and accents.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz_block: A clean white block made from four nether quartz. It is the base for quartz pillars, bricks and stairs. Smelt it for smooth quartz.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz_bricks: Quartz shaped into bricks. Craft four quartz blocks into four, or use a stonecutter. They give white builds more texture.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz_pillar: A ribbed column of quartz. Craft two quartz blocks stacked, or use a stonecutter. Place it sideways for horizontal beams.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz_stairs: Stairs made of quartz. Craft six quartz blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit clean, modern builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_terracot: Terracotta dyed white. Craft eight terracotta around white dye, or find it in badlands. Smelt it into white glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_terraco: Terracotta dyed orange, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around orange dye. Smelt it into orange glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_terrac: Terracotta dyed magenta. Craft eight terracotta around magenta dye. Smelt it into magenta glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_ter: Terracotta dyed light blue. Craft eight terracotta around light blue dye. Smelt it into light blue glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_terraco: Terracotta dyed yellow, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around yellow dye. Smelt it into yellow glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_terracott: Terracotta dyed lime. Craft eight terracotta around lime dye. Smelt it into lime glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_terracott: Terracotta dyed pink. Craft eight terracotta around pink dye. Smelt it into pink glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_terracott: Terracotta dyed gray. Craft eight terracotta around gray dye. Smelt it into gray glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_ter: Terracotta dyed light gray, found in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around light gray dye. Smelt it into light gray glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cyan_terracott: Terracotta dyed cyan. Craft eight terracotta around cyan dye. Smelt it into cyan glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purple_terraco: Terracotta dyed purple. Craft eight terracotta around purple dye. Smelt it into purple glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_terracott: Terracotta dyed blue. Craft eight terracotta around blue dye. Smelt it into blue glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_terracot: Terracotta dyed brown, found in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around brown dye. Smelt it into brown glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_terracot: Terracotta dyed green. Craft eight terracotta around green dye. Smelt it into green glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_terracotta: Terracotta dyed red, common in badlands. Craft eight terracotta around red dye. Smelt it into red glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.black_terracot: Terracotta dyed black. Craft eight terracotta around black dye. Smelt it into black glazed terracotta.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.barrier: An invisible, unbreakable block used by map makers. It blocks movement but can't be seen without holding one. It can only be obtained with commands.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light: An invisible block that gives off light, used by map makers. Its brightness can be set from 0 to 15. It can only be obtained with commands.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hay_block: Nine wheat bundled into a bale. Horses and llamas eat it, and it softens falls a lot. Placed under a campfire, it makes the smoke rise much higher.
